items.quote: you who are in the other two companies that normally go off Sabbath duty are all to guard the temple for the king.
items.contrast: The two companies going off Sabbath duty were to guard the temple for the king, whereas guarding the royal palace was assigned to a third of the three companies going on duty.
items.reason: “Guard the royal palace” is plausible because it appears among the nearby Sabbath assignments, but it applies to a different group. The stem clearly identifies the two off-duty companies, and the passage gives them one unambiguous duty.
